decisions.statement: A movement Alan may not perform is gone before any movement is ranked.
A movement Alan's kit cannot load is one Alan may not perform.
What Alan owns is read from the kit pages rather than written here.
A movement naming no kit and a movement of the body alone are always loadable.
A movement is out where every muscle it trains is at its weekly ceiling.
A stretch and a bout of cardio are no movements to rank.
The muscle owed the most against its weekly floor picks the movement.
A movement is chosen from those training that muscle as a primary one.
The pattern least covered this week leads among the movements for that muscle.
How Alan is today is read from the sets Alan has logged today.
The first movement of a bout is one Alan has taken near failure before.
A movement new to Alan is offered only once Alan has worked today.
A bout takes no more movements new to Alan than the selection policy allows.
A movement offered carries the weight to use and a number of reps to beat.
The weight is the heaviest Alan took near failure, and the reps are one past it.
A movement Alan's kit cannot load further holds its weight and climbs its reps.
A movement Alan never took near failure carries no weight and no reps.
How long Alan was away is no reason to offer more or less.
Every muscle being at its ceiling is answered as rest rather than refused.
A run writes nothing.
Muscles owed alike are parted by the movement Alan has the deepest history with.
A movement Alan may not perform is one a restriction names the pattern of.
The kit keeping a movement out is tested on every run rather than on a day.
A movement is dropped when that movement stops progressing rather than after a fixed time.
A bout without progress is a day Alan took the movement near failure without beating its best.
A dropped movement is offered again once its pattern has progressed elsewhere.
A movement Alan turns down counts against that movement as much as a set counts for it.
A movement Alan turned down today is out for today.
A movement whose reps have run out as well as its kit holds both and is slowed instead.
Every run ranks every movement again, so nothing is offered for having been offered.
Stimulus against fatigue parts two movements the pattern and the history leave alike.

definition: the movement to do next, with the load to take and what to beat
